caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Adams Dairy, Inc.
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Adams Dairy, Inc.
attorneys: Solicitor General Cox, Arnold Ordman, Dominick L. Manoli and Norton J. Come for petitioner., J. Leonard Schemer for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the United States' Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit for reconsideration in light of Fibreboard Paper Products Corp. v. Labor Board, ante, p. 203.
